messages:
nina_engineer: Hey team, quick edge case: holiday falls on Tue, I'm flying Mon evening and want Mon afternoon off (half-day PTO) + Tue holiday. Our manager is out but told me to ask if approvals can be delegated to Devon. Is delegation allowed for PTO approvals during blackout-ish weeks?

maria_peopleops: Short answer: managers can delegate approval authority temporarily, but it must be logged. Ask your manager to add Devon as the "PTO approver delegate" in the Delegation Form so we have an audit trail.

nina_engineer: Manager already DM'd Devon saying yes. Do I need a formal ticket or is the DM ok?

devon_manager: I saw the DM. I can approve, but per policy we need a formal delegation entry. Nina can submit the quick Delegation Request: `https://intranet.redwood/forms/delegation` with manager name + dates and Ill sign off.

maria_peopleops: Correct. Without the delegation record, payroll may flag approvals during blackout windows. One more wrinkle: you mentioned a half-day. We support half-day PTOs; record as `0.5 day` in the PTO form. If the holiday is a company holiday on Tue you won't use PTO that day.

peopleops_bot: Handbook excerpt: "Managers may delegate PTO approval for specified dates via Delegation Form; delegation must be completed before the PTO start date." (leave v3.5) https://intranet.redwood/handbook/leave#delegation

nina_engineer: Thanks. Also wondering if taking the half-day Monday affects carryover eligibility since it's end-of-Q4 for me. If I take Monday am and the holiday Tue, does that change my year-end carry balance?

olivia_payroll: Taking PTO reduces your unused vacation balance immediately. Carryover calculation runs at year-end snapshot (Dec 31 23:59 UTC). If you use hours before that snapshot, they aren't available to carry. Note: carried balance is capped at 40h for FT; partial-day usage counts against that.

maria_peopleops: If this is in a release blackout, please ensure Devon notes coverage in the request. Also if you need an exception for carryover because project prevented using PTO, submit "Carryover Exception" with manager justification.

nina_engineer: Filed Delegation form and PTO request (PTO-REQ-9301) with note: "delegate Devon approved via DM; half-day AM 12/30 + holiday 12/31".

devon_manager: Approved PTO-REQ-9301. Added coverage note: "paired with oncall swap; no gaps".

maria_peopleops: All good. We'll confirm delegation record; payroll will process holiday pay as usual. If you later need to request carryover exception, submit by Dec 20.

peopleops_bot: Ticket created: #PTO-9301 (delegation + PTO). Payroll notified. Expected processing: 3 business days.
